articles.title: AW26: Between Concrete and Quiet
articles.excerpt: A wool jacket, a long trouser, and the space between them. Notes on the AW26 silhouette.
articles.html:
The starting point is a straight line: the edge of a shoulder, the fall of a trouser, a seam running down the back. AW26 keeps that line clear, then gives it room to move.

A softer frame

The Architectural Wool Jacket sits away from the body. Its broad shoulder meets an unhurried hem, with enough space underneath for a fine knit. The Column Wide Trouser carries the same proportion through the leg.

Charcoal, stone, and off-white hold the collection together. The contrast comes from texture: a dry wool surface beside a compact knit, a smooth nylon shell against the grain of a leather tote.

Worn in motion

These pieces are imagined for the walk between places. A jacket worn open. A tote held low. Layers that can be added without changing the silhouette.

articles.title: Material Note: Soft Structure
articles.excerpt: Why a quiet surface and a little weight change the way a knit sits.
articles.html:
Structure does not have to feel stiff. For the Soft Structure Knit, the idea is a compact surface with an easy shoulder: a layer that holds its outline while following the wearer.

Texture before decoration

The synthetic catalog specifies a wool and cotton blend. Wool brings softness; cotton gives the imagined fabric a drier touch. A close neckline and restrained rib finish keep attention on the proportion.

Wear it alone with a wide trouser, or beneath the Architectural Wool Jacket. The slightly dropped shoulder leaves space through the upper body without adding a heavy layer.

A slower care routine

Air between wears, fold rather than hang, and follow the product's care notes before washing. The composition and care details in this demo are illustrative specifications, not certifications for a manufactured garment.

articles.title: Seoul / Tokyo / Transit
articles.excerpt: One small wardrobe, imagined across two cities. Nylon, wool, and a bag for the journey.
articles.html:
A city wardrobe is assembled in small decisions. What fits under the shell. Which bag leaves a hand free. How a trouser falls over a shoe after a long walk.

Three layers, one outline

The Transit Nylon Shell is the outer layer of this imagined journey. Underneath, the Soft Structure Knit adds a quieter texture. The Column Wide Trouser finishes a long, loose line.

The Folded Crescent Bag stays close to the body; the Atelier Leather Tote gives the same outfit more carrying space. Neither needs a different wardrobe around it.

Across the route

Seoul and Tokyo are references for the pace of the editorial: a platform, a concrete passage, an early street. The visuals are synthetic compositions, not photographs of a commissioned shoot or named location.
